purpose: Finite source-informed bot-rule screen, annual growth and short-period outcome distributions. Historical simulation only; no LLM-generated historical decisions.

rules.name: Buy and hold
rules.formula: Always long after common 252-row signal warmup.

rules.name: SMA200 control
rules.formula: Long iff completed adjusted close > rolling200 mean.

rules.name: Donchian55/20 control
rules.formula: Enter close > maximum previous55 closes; exit close < minimum previous20 closes.

rules.name: MACD
rules.formula: Long iff EMA12(close)-EMA26(close) > EMA9(of that difference); pandas ewm adjust=False, seeded first observation.

rules.name: Bollinger breakout
rules.formula: Enter close > SMA20+2 populationSD20; exit close < SMA20.

rules.name: Bollinger recovery
rules.formula: Enter previous close < previous SMA20-2 populationSD20 and current close >= current lower band; exit close >= SMA20 or after5 signal intervals.

rules.name: Stochastic recovery
rules.formula: RawK=100*(close-min14 low)/(max14 high-min14 low); slowK=mean3(rawK). Enter previous slowK<=20 and current slowK>20; exit slowK>=80 or10 signal intervals. Zero range invalidates entry.

rules.name: Keltner breakout
rules.formula: TrueRange=max(high-low,abs(high-previousclose),abs(low-previousclose)); ATR20=simple mean20(TR). Enter close>EMA20+2ATR20; exit close<EMA20.

rules.name: Squeeze release
rules.formula: Bollinger SMA20 +/-2 populationSD20 inside EMA20 +/-1.5ATR20 on previous session, outside today and close>SMA20: enter. Exit close<SMA20 or10 signal intervals.

rules.name: Volume breakout
rules.formula: Enter close>maximum previous20 closes and volume>1.5*mean previous20 volume; exit close<SMA10 or10 signal intervals. Current-vintage split-adjusted volume caveat.

rules.name: Completed-day gap continuation
rules.formula: Enter after adjusted open/previous adjusted close-1 in[.02,.15], close>open, volume>=1.5*mean previous20 volume; exit after1 signal interval. Grok-desk inspired local proxy, no nominal price screen/current movers/LLM/news replication.

rules.name: Completed-day gap recovery
rules.formula: Enter after adjusted open/previous adjusted close-1 in[-.15,-.02], close>open, volume>=1.5*mean previous20 volume; exit after1 signal interval. Same proxy limitations as B08.

rules.name: Downshock reversal
rules.formula: Enter close/previousclose-1 <= -2*sampleSD(previous20 close returns) and close>SMA200; exit after5 signal intervals.

rules.name: Range expansion
rules.formula: Enter TR>2*mean previous20 TR and (close-low)/(high-low)>=.8; exit after3 signal intervals; zero range invalidates entry.

rules.name: Fixed vote
rules.formula: Long iff at least2 of MACDhist>0, close>SMA50, close/close20sessionsago-1>0. Related ensemble, not independent alpha.

accounting.price_basis: Adjusted OHLC = vendor OHLC*(Adj Close/Close), retrospective total-return wealth units, NOT nominal whole shares. Vendor actions/payable dates not validated; no integer-feasibility claim.
accounting.trades: Signals use completed close. Shift desired state by1/2 signal sessions, then execute on that observed session open. Entry/exit only on state changes, no daily rebalance. New cash account may enter its first active delayed state. Exit first; no same-decision reentry. All exits are next-open, never intraday stops.
accounting.cash: Sale proceeds assumed immediately reusable on subsequent scheduled openings; no cash settlement certification. Single asset/no same-bar sell-and-buy/no shorting.
accounting.terminal: Liquidate any remaining wealth units at final observed close with same one-way cost for consistent funded ending value; these terminal sales are diagnostic scheduled endpoints, not strategy forecasts.
accounting.drawdown: Include initial cash, each pretrade open mark, postcost open mark and closing mark, including terminal liquidation; daily extrema remain unobserved.

data_rules.missing: Reject nonfinite/invalid prices, duplicate dates or missing underlying date. No forward filling. Record actual available period; full histories differ by inception. Comparisons are matched within asset and window.
data_rules.leveraged: Only actual SSO/QLD/UPRO/TQQQ/TECL prices. Signals on SPY/QQQ/XLK; no synthetic leverage/backfill. TECL evaluation starts2012-07-02 after benchmark change. Fund fees/financing embedded in observed series, not charged twice.
data_rules.known_bias: 11 handpicked surviving stocks; all inputs current-vintage and already used. Neither later split nor newly written rule creates an untouched holdout.

short_periods.starts: First observed eligible session of every calendar month from2000 through2025, separately for each asset; require full horizon. Fresh$1000, common state from preceding completed data.10bps/side lag1. Save every start even no trades. Horizons overlap and are not independent.

selection.method: Within each asset choose maximum training CAGR among B01..B12 at10bps lag1, tie ascending rule ID. Report that frozen choice in fresh later period allcost/lag cases. Also report hindsight leaders clearly labelled. No select-on-later promotion.
selection.multiple_testing: All405 rule-asset configurations retained. Costs/windows/lags/starts are scenarios not new independent strategies. No significance or future-profit claim; no additional parameter retuning after results.

options: Separate official benchmark-history protocol to be frozen before any option-index performance; existing contract quote limitation remains. This registration does not invent option fills.
output: All primary summaries, annual returns, original-input/source hashes, signals, compressed daily funded ledgers and all monthly fresh-start results. Private raw inputs and full ledgers outside public Git; public summaries/check receipts.
